channel.title: SpaceTime Drive
channel.description: Live update feed for SpaceTime Drive.

item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
What's new in 2.2.0

  • Drop-to-upload. Drag files or entire folders onto a drive card and they stream straight to the cloud — no local disk staging. Pick the destination folder, watch one batch progress bar with a live time estimate.
  • Stop / Resume & Retry all. Halt a batch any time and resume where it left off; one click re-drives anything a network blip interrupted.
  • Finder shows the truth. New uploads appear within seconds — no more unmount/remount. The refresh button now genuinely re-reads every drive from the cloud.
  • Instant browsing. Folders you've visited open instantly from a smart cache while the cloud is re-checked in the background.
  • Free Up Space. One fast click evicts local copies; files stay in Finder and in the cloud, re-downloading on demand.
  • Under the hood. Huge batches no longer slow down or freeze the app; cross-drive folder moves are crash-safe; sign-in works even offline.

item.title: Version 2.1.4
item.description:
What's new in 2.1.4

  • Auto-update. The app now checks for new versions automatically and offers a one-click install — no more manual downloads.
  • Live cross-user updates. When a teammate uploads or deletes a file, your Finder reflects the change within about half a second instead of needing a refresh or remount.
  • Live access control. When the admin grants or revokes a drive in Users & Access, the producer's app picks it up without signing out.
  • File sizes update correctly after upload — no more stuck-at-0-bytes display.
  • Users & Access modal got a frozen first column so the user name stays visible while you scroll through drives.
